## Core services

- Full-stack web development: responsive frontend interfaces, JavaScript interactions, PHP/MySQL backend functionality, database workflows, integrations, testing, and production deployment.
- Developer support: issue tracking, code updates, bug triage, Git workflows, and practical development assistance.
- Website maintenance: content updates, bug checks, responsive layout cleanup, hosting support, backups, and frontend or PHP adjustments.
- PHP/MySQL troubleshooting: database checks, query review, login support, error tracing, and system fixes.
- Data and report automation: spreadsheet cleanup, data validation, recurring summaries, and repeatable reporting workflows.
- Technical documentation: setup guides, system notes, troubleshooting references, workflow documentation, and handover materials.
- UI and design support: interface cleanup, responsive improvements, Photoshop edits, and Canva assets.
- Deployment assistance: Git updates, Linux/Nginx checks, XAMPP/Laragon setup, PM2 checks, and deployment troubleshooting.

## Technical skills
